cc65816.version: Calypsi ISO C compiler for 65816 version 5.18

pin.scope: GEM VDI development: FX 1.26 at D600, private 512 KiB VRAM, inactive at cold boot. Detection only is tested by G0.

peripherals.name: happy-none
peripherals.firmware: built-in high-level model; quiet command only

observer.mode: same binary, EXEC816_LATENCY_TRACE and EXEC816_MASK_TRACE environment gates; replay with both unset

keyboard_input.mode: POKEY matrix scan; PushRawKey/ReleaseRawKey immediate=false; modifier matrix transitions
keyboard_input.initialization: KEY ALL up enables scan mode before modifier changes

mouse_input.mapping: unmodified built-in preset; all other input maps disabled in isolated test profile
mouse_input.host_path: ATInputManager::OnMouseMove(0, dx, dy); OnButtonChanged(0, MouseLMB, state)
mouse_input.sensitivity: default preset: 16 integer host units per electrical transition; no mapping acceleration
mouse_input.capture: headless scheduled relative motion; GUI uses normal host mouse capture
mouse_input.observer: EXEC816_MOUSE_TRACE=1 logs MOUSE_HOST and passive MOUSE_PHASE in base scheduler cycles; unset for replay
mouse_input.controller_timing: Unmodified slow (scanline) scheduler: each phase delay clamps 0x1000000/remaining fixed-point distance to 1..256 scanlines. The passive observer timestamps output on the base CPU scheduler.

access_timing.scope: Conservative CPU charge excludes native interrupts and off-Task time. Two first units contain an injected Yield; access_wait includes arbitration and bridge costs.

upper.grant_allocation: Caller-owned; no production grants allocated by WA3. Up to 256 payload bytes if all eight are supplied.

changes: FIFO delegated access and retained Task grants; nonblocking nested owner admission; native DMA pin until owner retirement.
Every shared native drawing entry uses arbitration; presenter reserves one bounded service turn and drops before Yield/Wait.
Quiescent recovery revokes/wakes borrowers but keeps lifetime teardown in the owner. Unquiesced hardware retains active grant and parks at FF93.
Generated IOStdReq C padding fixes offset 38 and size 42; every C image now checks native I/O layouts.
limitations: Instrumented 48-unit fill timing includes assertions/markers and two forced yields; these are not full application VDI stack or latency results.

The native coexistence write took 2309 ms in its observed window versus 1584 ms in the WA2 control. The previous six-second hold left less than two seconds after gesture setup and failed; an eight-second bounded functional hold passes. PI4/HY4 limits are unchanged and remain open.
The WA2 control also exposed a stale fixture heap expectation omitting the GUI delivery record. The corrected expectation includes aligned storage.
No application workstations or counter demo yet; WA4-WA6 follow.
The final GrantClose owner-wake addition is covered by the final raw/optimized arbitration tests (63 assertions each); earlier integration/timing image hashes remain recorded as executed.
